GPTR-F-001-S47.title: Allowlist Configuration and Versioning
GPTR-F-001-S47.description: Implement centralized allowlist configuration (collections, fields, operators, limits) with explicit versioning and environment scoping (dev/qa/prod). Ensure runtime reads immutable snapshot per request.

GPTR-F-001-S48.title: Structured Rejection and Error Contract
GPTR-F-001-S48.description: Define and enforce consistent error response schema for rejected requests including reason codes (schema_invalid, allowlist_violation, limit_exceeded) and no data leakage of restricted fields.

GPTR-F-001-S49.title: Audit Logging for Enforcement Decisions
GPTR-F-001-S49.description: Log all enforcement decisions (allow/deny) with request metadata, reason codes, and truncated payload snapshot to audit store without exposing sensitive data.

GPTR-F-001-S50.title: Query Limit and Payload Guardrails
GPTR-F-001-S50.description: Enforce hard limits on query size, document count, projection breadth, and response payload (e.g., 500KB cap, 100-doc limit) prior to execution.

GPTR-F-001-S51.title: Auth Scope Binding to Allowlist
GPTR-F-001-S51.description: Bind bearer token scopes to allowlist segments ensuring requests are validated against both identity scope and global allowlist before execution.
